description: Walk declared relations from a start (a record, a filter or a search) and return rows or a graph. Covers neighbours, traversal, paths and subgraphs, whole-graph measures (degree centrality, connected components and PageRank) and the cheapest walk. A graph whose steps all start at depth 0 is one walk over their relations, each in its own step's direction and depth; any other is a chain, as rows walk it; a graph cut by `limit` pages with `next_cursor`. Rows and an aggregate may branch and join: a step's `from` names an earlier name, `join` closes a cycle, `optional` binds null where nothing matches and `absent` keeps a row only where nothing does. A path (`to`) has one start and answers a graph, or with `cheapest` rows. A measure is computed whole for every page: read it in one page, with `limit` up to the lake's `max_graph_nodes`.

as_of.description: Read the lake as it was at this position; now() is the time it was written, unless valid_at names one.

items.description: One sort key of the rows: a path they hold, by its value.

as.description: `degree` answers rows of `type`, `key` and `degree` (links over the steps' relations), highest first; `components` answers rows of `component`, `size`, `type` and `key`, largest component first; with no start `type` it grows from every linked record, in every type. Both take steps without `depth`, `where` or `type`; `components` walks each step `both`. `reach` answers rows of `step`, `depth`, `type` and `key`: what each step reaches from what the step before it kept, dead ends included, each record at the first step that reaches it. `page_rank` answers rows of `type`, `key` and `page_rank` over the graph the start reaches, each step in its own direction, highest first, the same on every engine; like `components` it takes steps without `depth`, `where` or `type`, and may leave the start `type` out. `cheapest` needs `to` and one start: rows of `hop`, `type`, `key`, `relation`, `walk` and `cost` along the walk that costs least, a link costing its `weight` field, then the fewest hops.

weight.description: For `cheapest`: the number or decimal field of every step's link type that a link costs.

as.description: The name a row binds this record under, `<name>.<field>`; its type's name when left out. Two records of one type in a row need a name each.

params.description: The parameters of a view the pattern starts on, by name.

text.description: What the window is ranked against; the search's own text when left out, so a vector search must give it.

top.description: How many of the first hits the lake's reranker ranks again, at most the lake's `limits.max_rerank_top`; the answer ends at this window.

absent.description: Keep the row only where the step has no match from its `from`; with `join`, only where no walk reaches the joined record. It binds no name and takes no `as`.

as.description: The name a row binds this step's records under, `<name>.<field>`, with `<name>.key`, `<name>._type` and `<name>._depth`; its type's name when left out, or its relation's where it reaches several types. Name a step that may reach several types: left out, its name follows the types its reader is shown.

from.description: The name this step walks from: the start's, or one an earlier step binds; the one the step before it binds when left out. Two steps from one name branch, and a row is a match of every branch. Rows and an aggregate only.

join.description: A name an earlier step binds: the step holds only where it reaches that name's record, closing a cycle. It binds no name and takes no `as`, `type` or `where`.

optional.description: Keep the row where the step has no match: its name's `key`, `_type` and `_depth` are null. A step from or joining it says `optional` too, and they match whole or are null whole.

to.description: [type, key]: return only the shortest walk to this record.

valid_at.description: Read what was true in the world at this instant; now() and today() are this instant.

description: Ranked search over one type, lexical, by vector or both. Hits come best first, each with a score; page with `cursor`. With `rerank` the lake's reranker ranks the first `top` hits again and the answer ends at that window.

also.description: vector: further vector fields, each {field, vector, weight, model}, fused with `field` by weighted rank.

as_of.description: Read the lake as it was at this position; now() is the time it was written, unless valid_at names one.

fields.description: lexical and hybrid: match the text only in these searchable fields.

matches.description: Answer on each hit the searched fields its text matched, each with the char spans of its first 32 matched tokens and their count; needs a text.

model.description: The model that made `vector`, named only beside it; over a field that is a model's embedding, it must be that model.

text.description: What the window is ranked against; the search's own text when left out, so a vector search must give it.

top.description: How many of the first hits the lake's reranker ranks again, at most the lake's `limits.max_rerank_top`; the answer ends at this window.

text_fields.description: lexical and hybrid: a weight for a match of the text in each searchable field named, over the type's `search_weights` setting; a field it leaves out takes the setting's, else 1.

valid_at.description: Read what was true in the world at this instant; now() and today() are this instant.

weight.description: The weight of `field`'s ranking against the text's (`text_weight`) or the fields' in `also`.

name: search

truncated.description: A reranked search only: the first stage holds more hits than the window, unranked and not answered.

description: Be told of changes without polling: from `from` on (by default, from now), this session is sent a `notifications/lakelands/changed` for every change of a record it may read, of the kinds, types and keys asked (by default every kind, every type it may read when the change happens, and every record). A notification names the position, the kind, the type, the key and the changed fields it may read; never a value. Subscribing again replaces the subscription; it ends with the session.

from.description: The first position to be told of; the one after the current head when left out.

keys.description: Only the records with these keys, fixed now: of the types asked, or of any type when none are; every record when left out. One record's history is one type and one key.

kinds.description: Only these kinds of change; every kind when left out.

types.description: Only these types, fixed now; every type readable at each change when left out.
